1) Initial triage: infra metrics show increased queue depth on the connector pool servicing TidalLabs from 08:45–09:05 PT. No config rollouts from our side in the last 24h.

2) Short-term mitigation (within 30–60m):
   - We can enable a dedicated small-scale fallback route to your secondary endpoint (if you have one) — please confirm endpoint and credentials.
   - Reduce default batch size for your tenant to 4 → this is a runtime toggle we can apply quickly.
   - Enable temporary request-level retry with jitter to smooth spikes.

3) Next steps:
   - I'm scheduling a 30-minute bridge at 10:00 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/3e9f-tidallabs-triage). Please confirm availability.
   - Jordan / Marissa: can you validate capacity on the dedicated pool and confirm whether we should scale an extra worker for the next 2 hours?

I'll share a short escalation runbook after the bridge that formalizes the handoff and SLAs.

-Karthik

- Switched TidalLabs to secondary.ingest.tidallabs.com for 2 hours (confirmed by Raisa).
- Reduced batch size for tenant to 4 at runtime.
- Enabled request jittered retries (max 2) and verified idempotency header passthrough.
- Brought up one extra worker (prov-8734) in dedicated pool.

Runbook (attached) — highlights:
- Escalation tiers:
  Tier 1 (minutes): on-call engineer (Dylan Brooks) for immediate mitigation.
  Tier 2 (1 hour): Partner Integrations lead (Karthik) for coordination and SLA decisions.
  Tier 3 (4 hours): Director Ops (Jordan) and Head of Partnerships (Marissa) for contractual exceptions.
- Owner matrix with after-hours phone rotations and PagerDuty IDs.
- Fallback routing steps and play-by-play for rollback.

Open items for TidalLabs:
- Share the idempotency key header name you use (so we can normalize).
- Confirm whether you want temporary 99.5% availability SLO for the affected window or to keep the standard SLO with credit remediation.

I'll push the attached proposed-escalation-runbook-v1.pdf to our shared Drive and update after your feedback.

Thanks — actions look stable for now but we should reconvene after tonight's window.

-Karthik
